title: Mirrormate — human label, not a model NEEDS_REVIEW verdict
banner: SAMPLE hash chain over a human label copied from data/eval/gate1_labels.json. This is not a Nightshift trace and not a model verdict.
summary: Human label says CANDIDATE or NEEDS_REVIEW would be acceptable. No committed file records a model verdict of NEEDS_REVIEW.

verdict.reason: The repository's own README says the agent lives in a mirror and is not a browser chat UI. A browser voice assistant that does not say it runs in a mirror is not full overlap.
verdict.quote: A voice-first AI designed to live in a mirror

gate2.rule_quote: **Gate 2 only runs if gate 1 said `CANDIDATE`.** This is a hard precondition (commit `aa48ca7`). For any other gate-1 verdict the state is `NOT_ATTEMPTED_GATE1`, the trace records `REVIVE_BLOCKED_BY_GATE1`, and nothing is cloned, installed or patched.
gate2.why: No gate-2 trace is committed for this repository. NOT_ATTEMPTED_GATE1 applies when a recorded gate-1 verdict is not CANDIDATE. This card is a human label, so that state was not recorded here.
